Class Domain

java.lang.Object
org.clafer.domain.Domain
Direct Known Subclasses:
BoolDomain
public class Domain extends Object
Immutable domain over integers. Internally stored as a list of (low, high) disjoint pairs of regions.
Author:
jimmy

      public boolean isBounded()
      Checks if this domain is defined as a lower and upper bound. If the domain is bounded then it contains every value between its lower and upper bound.

      true if and only if this domain is a single contiguous region, false otherwise
